content:
{
  "voter": "Codex (GPT-5.1)",
  "round": 12,
  "audit_summary": "Well-structured B2B site with solid AI-friendliness and clean technical foundations, but two critical contractual violations (PLYCEM in titles) and several high-impact SEO gaps (incomplete sitemap, missing edge cache, stale llms.txt) need immediate attention before launch.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "dimension": "onpage_seo",
      "severity": "critical",
      "title": "SB-5 violation: PLYCEM appears in all page title tags",
      "evidence": "§4.3 live title tags; §4.5 root layout metadata; §4.7 product detail metadata; §4.8 Spanish page metadata. All observed titles contain the word 'PLYCEM'.",
      "issue": "SB-5 contractually forbids any 'PLYCEM' in <title> tags. Current homepage title reads 'PLYCEM Non-Combustible Subfloor...', product detail titles read '...PLYCEM Fiber-Cement Panel', and Spanish landing reads '...PLYCEM Entrepiso Alto Desempeño...'. This is a direct blocker.",
      "fix": "Rewrite all title tags to exclude 'PLYCEM'. Homepage: 'Non-Combustible Fiber-Cement Subfloor – Multifamily & Commercial USA | JARA International Inc.'. Product detail: '%s – Fiber-Cement Panel | JARA International Inc.'. Spanish: 'JARA International Inc. – Entrepiso Alto Desempeño Subfloor en EE.UU. | JARA International Inc.'. Update layout.tsx default title and per-page metadata accordingly.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": "SB-5"
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "dimension": "technical_seo",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Sitemap is a static stub with only one URL",
      "evidence": "§4.12 public/sitemap.xml contains only the homepage URL; §4.4 confirms no app/sitemap.ts exists.",
      "issue": "Critical product pages, resources, contact, service areas, and Spanish page are missing from sitemap. Crawlers will have difficulty discovering deep content, hurting indexation and ranking.",
      "fix": "Generate a dynamic sitemap at build time (next-sitemap or app/sitemap.ts) that includes all <url> entries for every page (en + es), each with correct <lastmod>, <changefreq>, <priority>, and <xhtml:link> hreflang alternates pointing to themselves and the Spanish version where available. Ensure the robots.txt sitemap directive stays correct.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "dimension": "ai_friendliness",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "llms.txt lists only 6 of 9 products",
      "evidence": "§4.13 public/llms.txt explicitly lists 6 products; §4.4 catalog has 9 product slugs.",
      "issue": "AI systems parsing llms.txt will miss Deck Modular, Lap Siding Tongue & Groove, and Corrugated Roof Tile. This undercuts AI discoverability for the expanded catalog.",
      "fix": "Update public/llms.txt to list all 9 products with correct names and short descriptions. Ensure the update process is automated alongside sitemap generation to avoid drift.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "dimension": "performance",
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Prerendered HTML responses lack 'public' directive, preventing Cloudflare edge cache",
      "evidence": "§4.2 live headers show Cache-Control: s-maxage=31536000 but no CF-Cache-Status and x-nextjs-cache: MISS; worker returns 100ms CPU time on active deployment.",
      "issue": "Without the 'public' keyword, Cloudflare treats the response as uncacheable (private or cookie-dependent). Users and crawlers always hit the worker, causing unnecessary CPU consumption and slower responses. Combined with x-nextjs-cache: MISS, every request bypasses both Next.js and Cloudflare caches.",
      "fix": "Set Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=31536000, stale-while-revalidate=86400 on prerendered HTML routes. This can be done via middleware or by adjusting the default headers in open-next.config.ts. Verify CF-Cache-Status: HIT appears for subsequent requests.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "dimension": "schema",
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Product Offer uses 'areaServed', which is not a schema.org property of Offer",
      "evidence": "§4.9 lib/jsonld.ts productSchema defines offers: { areaServed: ... }.",
      "issue": "schema.org/Offer does not recognize 'areaServed'. The correct property is 'eligibleRegion' (for geographic suitability) or 'availableAtOrFrom' (for physical location). Using an invalid property may cause Google to ignore the structured data and lose eligibility for enhanced snippets.",
      "fix": "Replace 'areaServed' in the offers block with 'eligibleRegion', keeping the same array of Place names. Example: offers: { ..., eligibleRegion: SITE.serviceAreas.map(a => ({ '@type': 'Place', name: a })) }.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "dimension": "schema",
      "severity": "low",
      "title": "Organization schema missing logo/image",
      "evidence": "§4.9 lib/jsonld.ts organizationSchema lacks 'logo' or 'image'.",
      "issue": "Google's knowledge panel guidelines recommend a logo for Organization markup. Without it, branding in knowledge panels may be weaker.",
      "fix": "Add a logo field to organizationSchema referencing /images/og/og-default.svg or a dedicated logo file. Ensure the file meets Google's size requirements (112x112px min).",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "dimension": "ai_friendliness",
      "severity": "low",
      "title": "llms.txt uses secondary phone number inconsistent with SITE.phone",
      "evidence": "§4.13 llms.txt line 'Phone: +1 (415) 933-5738'; §4.10 lib/site.ts shows phonePrimary: '+1 (415) 532-3376'.",
      "issue": "AI assistants parsing llms.txt will cite a secondary number, potentially bypassing the Anna AI call screener on the primary line.",
      "fix": "Align llms.txt with the primary phone (+1 (415) 532-3376) unless the secondary number is intentionally the public-facing sales line. If both are needed, clearly label primary and secondary.",
      "ship_blocker_impact": null
    }
  ],
  "strengths": [
    "Comprehensive robot.txt with explicit AI-bot allowlisting and sitemap reference.",
    "Proper hreflang implementation with English US, Spanish US, and x-default across core pages.",
    "Well-formed structured data: Product, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, and Organization schemas all present and non-colliding.",
    "Modern image optimization (AVIF/WebP) and font loading with display:swap via next/font.",
    "AI-friendly architecture with /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, and /api/llm-context, plus clear citation guidance in llms.txt."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What is the actual heading hierarchy (H1, H2, H3) on homepage and product detail pages? Could not verify from artifacts.",
    "Are image alt texts meaningful and present across all ProductHero, ValueProps, and TrustBar images?",
    "Does app/not-found.tsx return a proper HTTP 404 status code?",
    "Is /llms-full.txt dynamically generated with all current product data, or does it also have a stale count?",
    "Are the 9 Cloudflare Worker errors tied to 404s, bot patterns, or code defects, and should a custom error boundary be implemented?",
    "Will enabling Smart Placement in wrangler.toml provide a meaningful latency reduction for the US-centric audience?",
    "Is the current absence of custon domain binding in wrangler.toml intentional (DNS-based routing) or a configuration oversight?"
  ]
}
